title: ezgoggles code flow
description: The code layer, personal (goggles-data/.local/code.json, not committed). Learning mode only. For the user's stage: the files that the data goes through, in order. Keys are stage ids.

time.description: When this was last written, local time.

steps.description: Files in the order that the data goes through them.

file.description: Path relative to the project root. Add ::name for one function, for example src/clean/fill.py::fill_gaps.

does.description: One short sentence: what this step does to the data.
